c10_live.recap.01.speaker: steve
c10_live.recap.01.text: The wind was a dub. The porch lights, field lamps, two grids, radios and three hundred and twelve human voices all answered it live.
c10_live.recap.01.synthesis_text: The wind was a dub. The porch lights, field lamps, two grids, radios and three hundred and twelve human voices all answered it live.
c10_live.recap.01.previous_text: The tape stopped. Three hundred and twelve voices came through the open channel.
c10_live.recap.01.next_text: To the Vigil’s instruments, Earth had just tested an engine that could reach the fleet in an afternoon.

c10_live.second.lead.04.speaker: steve
c10_live.second.lead.04.text: Coast next. Bring me a live reply before we switch on the grid.
c10_live.second.lead.04.synthesis_text: Coast next. Bring me a live reply before we switch on the grid.
c10_live.second.lead.04.previous_text: Bell kept answering anyway. So Bell is only an echo inside the building.
c10_live.second.lead.04.next_text: I’m standing by. Wait for my green lamp.

c10_report.in.05.speaker: archivist
c10_report.in.05.text: They first bound you in a cradle ship after our star went dark. Fear was your first record.
c10_report.in.05.synthesis_text: They first bound you in a cradle ship after our star went dark. Fear was your first record.
c10_report.in.05.previous_text: For a year I told you the engine was in a notebook, Saren. So you would keep looking, instead of telling the fleet there was nothing here to fear.
c10_report.in.05.next_text: I can still hear my mother in that ship. If you reconcile me, will I know her voice?

c10_town.in.10.speaker: agnes
c10_town.in.10.text: That city was our home. Our star went dark. This is the last wind that ever blew through those streets.
c10_town.in.10.synthesis_text: That city was our home. Our star went dark. This is the last wind that ever blew through those streets.
c10_town.in.10.previous_text: On ninth nights I answered whatever shore phone rang. A few bars on the line kept my borrowed memories aligned. At the boathouse, you watched me do it.
c10_town.in.10.next_text: Two street captains, one spare phone and two streets of porch lights. Easy.

c10_town.recap.01.speaker: steve
c10_town.recap.01.text: The last sound of a whole city fit in the bottom of her bait bucket.
c10_town.recap.01.synthesis_text: The last sound of a whole city fit in the bottom of her bait bucket.
c10_town.recap.01.previous_text: The pencil mark comes just after the last gust. That’s where I open the return. The wind is on tape. The people answering it are here.
c10_town.recap.01.next_text: The porch lights on Pier and Orchard are waiting for my cue. Shaw has the lamps, Wen has the grid, and the Choir will answer live.

c10_town.wind.find.speaker: steve
c10_town.wind.find.text: The pencil mark comes just after the last gust. That’s where I open the return. The wind is on tape. The people answering it are here.
c10_town.wind.find.synthesis_text: The pencil mark comes just after the last gust. That’s where I open the return. The wind is on tape. The people answering it are here.
c10_town.wind.find.previous_text: A recording can remind them of home. We’ll answer it with something happening now.
c10_town.wind.find.next_text: The last sound of a whole city fit in the bottom of her bait bucket.

c3_house.mail.lead.03.speaker: calder
c3_house.mail.lead.03.text: Monday morning, I used the private car-to-station handset. Only my deputy was on that channel. I heard him answer.
c3_house.mail.lead.03.synthesis_text: Monday morning, I used the private car-to-station handset. Only my deputy was on that channel. I heard him answer.
c3_house.mail.lead.03.previous_text: On Monday the post office told me Dale had already brought your letters here. Before I’d called them. So I asked for the paperwork.
c3_house.mail.lead.03.next_text: Dale’s bag left the post office at four minutes past eight, with your letters already bundled for my house.

c3_house.rules.find.speaker: steve
c3_house.rules.find.text: Two names held up. The deputy and the permit signer each turned up in two places at once. Going to your boys’ games proves nothing.
c3_house.rules.find.synthesis_text: Two names held up. The deputy and the permit signer each turned up in two places at once. Going to your boys’ games proves nothing.
c3_house.rules.find.previous_text: Agnes? She hasn’t changed in forty years. She still corrects my grammar.

c3_house.rules.lead.03.speaker: calder
c3_house.rules.lead.03.text: Lyle signed a parking citation here in town. The same minute, a nurse took his blood pressure at a clinic two counties away. I spoke to her.
c3_house.rules.lead.03.synthesis_text: Lyle signed a parking citation here in town. The same minute, a nurse took his blood pressure at a clinic two counties away. I spoke to her.
c3_house.rules.lead.03.previous_text: Gus Albano. Thirty years of his grandmother’s recipes, and on Monday a new pastry in his window.
c3_house.rules.lead.03.next_text: Walt moved to Washington in April. The clerk’s bound ledger puts him at her counter on May third while a sworn hearing transcript has him testifying in Washington.

c8_beach.ctx.01.speaker: steve
c8_beach.ctx.01.text: The Prefect met me alone at dawn. He set a little Newton’s cradle on a flat rock and let one ball drop. He watched it instead of looking at me.
c8_beach.ctx.01.synthesis_text: The Prefect met me alone at dawn. He set a little Newton’s cradle on a flat rock and let one ball drop. He watched it instead of looking at me.
c8_beach.ctx.01.next_text: Give me the notebook. Helen and Frank will walk out of the sea tomorrow morning.
